title: Logs
description: Search what your services, pipeline jobs and deployments write.

search.label: Search logs
search.trimmed: Older lines were dropped while following. Refresh to page back again.
search.empty: No log lines in this range
search.emptyHint: Widen the time range or change the filters. Services send lines with an ingest token.

tokens.description: Each token sends lines for one service. Treat tokens like passwords.
tokens.addDescription: The token can send lines only for the service you name here.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.serviceHint: Lowercase letters, digits, and . _ - /, for example shop/api.
tokens.serviceInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits, and . _ - / (starting with a letter or digit).
tokens.createdBody: Copy the token now: it won't be shown again.
tokens.limits: Send newline-delimited JSON, up to 1 MiB and 5,000 lines per request. Lines need a message; ts and level are optional.
tokens.emptyHint: Create a token for each service that should send logs.

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revoke.body: Services using this token can no longer send lines. Lines already stored are kept.
